notes: No database query request: the 2026-03-11 client reads data sources through `POST /v1/search` with the `data_source` filter; `notion_migrate` (not ported in Phase A) is the only caller of database trash, which `client_requests` covers.
Pacing (one request per 1/3 s) and retry sleeps are disabled in the generator; they change timing, not requests.

scenarios.description: One request of every NotionClient method: search (page, data_source, in_trash), get_page, page markdown GET and PATCH (replace_content, update_content), properties PATCH, move, create, trash and untrash, append_children, block children, property items (id percent-encoded), database trash.
scenarios.name: client_requests

scenarios.description: Two 429 answers with Retry-After: the identical GET is repeated until it succeeds.
scenarios.name: retry_rate_limited

scenarios.description: notion_sync.sync: data source search then page search, both paginated (page_size 100, start_cursor), then each page's markdown.
scenarios.name: sync

scenarios.description: The markdown endpoint refuses (400): the page text is read from block children, recursing into children except child_page.
scenarios.name: sync_blocks_fallback

scenarios.description: fetch_knowledge for a page missing from the mirror: live get_page then markdown.
scenarios.name: live_fetch

scenarios.description: notion_create_page under a hub: create, read back, create the Wiki Log page, prepend its line; undo trashes the page.
scenarios.name: wiki_create_page

scenarios.description: notion_update_page section replace, then append with sources and footer, each logged; undo restores the markdown.
scenarios.name: wiki_update_page

scenarios.description: notion_move_page to Wiki Home with an existing Wiki Log; undo moves it back.
scenarios.name: wiki_move_page

scenarios.description: notion_archive_page trashes the page and logs it; undo untrashes.
scenarios.name: wiki_archive_page

scenarios.description: Approved link proposal on a page without a Related section: freshness check, markdown read, append heading_2 plus bulleted link blocks, read back; undo replaces the markdown.
scenarios.name: proposal_link_append

scenarios.description: Approved link proposal on a page with a Related list: update_content inserts the link after the last item.
scenarios.name: proposal_link_related_section

scenarios.description: Approved edit proposal: freshness check, markdown read, update_content with the drafted replacements, read back.
scenarios.name: proposal_edit
